description: Get the exact `npx` install command for a skill. Use this when an agent has already selected a skill via marketnow_search_skills or marketnow_recommend_skills and is ready to install. All skills are currently FREE — no purchase step is required.

skill_id.description: Skill ID (e.g. mn-ai-00001) or slug. Alphanumeric and hyphens only.

name: marketnow_get_install_command
